repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Jeune 綜合徵（非典型軟骨發育異常）合併內臟位置轉位屬罕見先天性骨骼結構畸形，無已知免疫或干擾素軸相關致病機轉。IFN beta-1a 之免疫調節及抗病毒機轉與本症病理生理無明確橋接依據。

predicted_indications.disease_name: Pierre Robin syndrome associated with a chromosomal anomaly

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Pierre Robin 序列（小下頜、舌後墜、腭裂）合併染色體異常為發育性結構缺陷，病因屬基因組層級，IFN beta-1a 之免疫調節作用無法改變先天結構表現型。

predicted_indications.disease_name: partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 22

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 22q 長臂部分缺失（含 22q11.2 DiGeorge 相關區段）可影響胸腺發育與 T 細胞免疫，理論上存在免疫失調背景，但尚無任何臨床或臨床前研究顯示 IFN beta-1a 可針對此染色體缺失之表現型產生治療效益。

MS is often accompanied by various metabolic disturbances, with impaired creatine metabolism may play a role in its pathogenesis and the clinical course of the disease. literature.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
literature.abstract: Excessive alcohol consumption is a global healthcare problem with enormous social, economic, and clinical consequences. While chronic, heavy alcohol consumption causes structural damage and/or disrupts normal organ function in virtually every tissue of the body, the liver sustains the greatest damage. literature.title: Immunomodulators and immunosuppressants for relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis: a network meta-analysis.
literature.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
literature.abstract: Different therapeutic strategies are available for the treatment of people with relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS), including immunomodulators, immunosuppressants and biological agents. Although each one of these therapies reduces relapse frequency and slows disability accumulation compared to no treatment, their relative benefit remains unclear. This is an update of a Cochrane review published in 2015.

literature.title: Immunomodulators and immunosuppressants for progressive multiple sclerosis: a network meta-analysis.
literature.journal: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
literature.abstract: In recent years a broader range of immunomodulatory and immunosuppressive treatment options have emerged for people with progressive forms of multiple sclerosis (PMS). While consensus supports these options as reducing relapses, their relative benefit and safety profiles remain unclear due to a lack of direct comparison trials.

literature.title: Nebulised interferon beta-1a (SNG001) in the treatment of viral exacerbations of COPD.
literature.abstract: Respiratory viral infections are major drivers of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) exacerbations. Interferon-β is naturally produced in response to viral infection, limiting replication. This exploratory study aimed to demonstrate proof-of-mechanism, and evaluate the efficacy and safety of inhaled recombinant interferon-β1a (SNG001) in COPD. literature.title: Subcutaneous administration of interferon beta-1a for COVID-19: A non-controlled prospective trial.
literature.abstract: Recently, a new coronavirus spreads rapidly throughout the countries and resulted in a worldwide epidemic. Interferons have direct antiviral and immunomodulatory effects. Antiviral effects may include inhibition of viral replication, protein synthesis, virus maturation, or virus release from infected cells. Previous studies have shown that some coronaviruses are susceptible to interferons. The aim of this study was to evaluate the therapeutic effects of IFN-β-1a administration in COVID-19.

literature.title: Efficacy and safety of subcutaneous interferon-β-1a in patients with a first demyelinating event and early multiple sclerosis.
literature.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an inflammatory demyelinating disease of the CNS. Evidence suggests that MS should be treated as early as possible in order to maximize the benefit of treatment.

literature.title: Combination therapy with interferon beta-1a and sesame oil in multiple sclerosis.
literature.abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is an autoimmune disease of the central nervous system. Several effector mechanisms are involved in the immunopathology of MS and a variety of medications such as beta interferons are applied to treat the disease. This study was conducted to evaluate the anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects of sesame oil in combination with interferon beta-1a in MS treatment.

A large body of literature has reported the effect of immune-based therapies in patients with COVID-19, with some remarkable successes such as the use of steroids or anti-cytokine therapies. literature.title: Effect of intramuscular interferon beta-1a on gray matter atrophy in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis: A retrospective analysis.
literature.abstract: Changes in gray matter (GM) volume may be a useful measure of tissue loss in multiple sclerosis (MS).

literature.abstract: Interferon-beta-1a (IFN-beta-1a) is an approved treatment for multiple sclerosis (MS). It improves the disease course by reducing the relapse rate as well as the persistent neurological deficits. Recent MRI and post-mortem studies revealed that neuronal and axonal damage are most relevant for chronic disability in MS patients. literature.title: The effect of intravenous interferon-beta-1a (FP-1201) on lung CD73 expression and on acute respiratory distress syndrome mortality: an open-label study.
literature.abstract: Pulmonary vascular leakage occurs early in acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). Mortality is high (35-45%), but no effective pharmacotherapy exists. Production of anti-inflammatory adenosine by ecto-5'-nucleotidase (CD73) helps maintain endothelial barrier function. We tested whether interferon-beta-1a (IFN-beta-1a), which increases CD73 synthesis, can reduce vascular leakage and mortality in patients with ARDS.

literature.journal: Cold Spring Harbor perspectives in medicine
literature.abstract: Despite that the availability of new therapeutic options has expanded the multiple sclerosis (MS) disease-modifying therapy arsenal, interferon β (IFN-β) remains an important therapy option in the current decision-making process. This review will summarize the present knowledge of IFN-β mechanism of action, the overall safety, and the short- and long-term efficacy of its use in relapsing remitting MS and clinically isolated syndromes. literature.title: Interferon beta for multiple sclerosis.
literature.abstract: To introduce readers to the use of a new agent, interferon beta-1b (IFN beta ser), in the treatment of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS). Therapeutic and economic issues surrounding IFN beta ser are discussed, as are its pharmacology, clinical efficacy, adverse effects, and dosage guidelines.

literature.title: Efficacy of interferon beta-1a plus remdesivir compared with remdesivir alone in hospitalised adults with COVID-19: a double-bind, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial.
literature.abstract: Functional impairment of interferon, a natural antiviral component of the immune system, is associated with the pathogenesis and severity of COVID-19. We aimed to compare the efficacy of interferon beta-1a in combination with remdesivir compared with remdesivir alone in hospitalised patients with COVID-19.

literature.abstract: Prion diseases are fatal neurodegenerative disorders caused by misfolding of the normal prion protein (PrPC) into its infectious β-sheet-rich isoform (PrPSc). Conventionally, prions were thought to be incapable of eliciting robust immune responses because PrPC and PrPSc share an identical primary structure. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 岩藻醣苷合成障礙（如 CDG 相關糖蛋白合成缺陷）屬先天性代謝異常，核心缺陷為酵素功能喪失而非免疫失調。IFN beta-1a 的免疫調節作用（抑制 T 細胞活化、降低 BBB 通透性）與岩藻醣化途徑無明確藥理橋接。20 篇文獻經逐一比對，均為 IFN beta-1a 於 MS、COPD、COVID-19 之研究，與本症無直接關聯，屬文獻收集誤歸類。
Laubry-Pezzi 綜合徵（主動脈瓣下室間隔缺損合併主動脈瓣關閉不全）為先天性心臟結構異常，治療以外科或介入性修補為主，無已知免疫調節治療靶點。

predicted_indications.disease_name: partial deletion of the long arm of chromosome 7

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 7q 長臂缺失表現多樣（視缺失區段而定），主要為發育遲緩、智能障礙等神經發育問題。無已知 IFN beta-1a 相關治療靶點。
口顏面裂症候群為多因性先天結構缺陷（基因＋環境），治療以外科修補為主。無法透過免疫調節介入改變已形成之顏面結構。
與「Pierre Robin syndrome associated with a chromosomal anomaly」機轉評估相同，基因性症候群型 Pierre Robin 序列屬發育結構缺陷，IFN beta-1a 無治療合理性。
卵巢網囊腺瘤為良性婦科腫瘤，通常手術切除即可治癒。干擾素類製劑雖曾用於某些卵巢惡性腫瘤，但針對良性囊腺瘤無任何治療依據，且無免疫調節需求。
卵巢漿液性交界性腫瘤（LMP tumor）為低惡性潛能腫瘤，標準治療為保守性手術，5 年存活率 > 95%。干擾素類製劑在交界性卵巢腫瘤缺乏臨床研究支持，且益處/風險比不明。
